state:
- Exceptionally careful handling of S1–S4 separates supported premises from speculative bridges. However, exposure feasibility remains unquantified; establish human unbound concentration–time limits and physiological marrow-uridine conditions before defining efficacy criteria.
- Low salvage lacks an operational cutoff and direct causal validation. Define salvage relative to pyrimidine demand and perturb it bidirectionally. Genotype-positive maturation also cannot exclude survival of pre-existing mature leukemic cells; lineage-track initially immature malignant cells.
- Novelty rests primarily on low-salvage residual-disease stratification, not the established DHODH–AML connection. Check prior teriflunomide/leflunomide AML and salvage-resistance studies, then identify the genuinely distinct prediction.
